title: A restricted role cannot open a form outside its duties
preconditions: SANDBOX ONLY. Sign in as a test user whose only role is '{restrictedRole}' (saved session or dedicated account). Replace {menuItem} with a menu item that role must not have access to, for example a vendor payment journal for a role without AP duties. Read-only: do not change any data.

steps.action: Use the navigation search to look for '{menuItem}'.
steps.expected: The menu item is not offered in the results.

steps.action: Confirm the navigation pane shows no module that the role should not see.
steps.expected: Only modules that belong to '{restrictedRole}' are listed.
